posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I can't help but think of hockey as as sport played by schoolgirls on grass with a hard ball and with no protective gear if you're not the goalkeeper (not even shin pads when I played, which is a bad idea with a bunch of wooden sticks attempting to hit a hard plastic ball right near your feet).

Ice seems way too fast, the play area's too small, the ball's not even a ball and you can't really see it, and the players keep having to be told to go and sit down for a rest. Field hockey's literally a different ballgame.

I was brought up in a family of soccer fans so I became a fan by osmosis, if you like. Haven't watched it in years though.
